decisions.evidence: Putting the six neighbors together, all three mutagenic analogs align with the query’s oxy/carboxylic ester/amide pattern and similar ring or surface-area context, and even the three non-mutagenic analogs still show the query carrying extra oxy and amide features. The repeated presence of those shared structural motifs, along with the query’s higher ring count relative to several neighbors and only modestly higher QED, makes the balance favor option (B): is mutagenic.
